_description: Enters on strong directional 1m candles confirmed by above-average volume. This is a candle-momentum proxy, NOT real order-book depth (L2 OBI requires live WebSocket tick data unavailable in historical OHLCV). Long-only. Single position at a time.
_signal: body_ratio = (close-open)/(high-low) ≥ 0.60 AND volume_z-score ≥ 1.0 AND candle_range ≥ 0.03% of price
_cost_model: fee_rate 0.1%/side + slippage 0.05%/side = 0.31% round-trip; TP=0.6% provides ~0.29% net edge per winning trade
